Game Overview

At its heart, Cafe 3 in a Row is a mahjong game about tile your way through a culinary-themed puzzle adventure, where organizing vibrant cafe-inspired tiles grants a satisfying sense of order. Relax and strategize as you match three-of-a-kind to clear the screen, using power-ups when needed, in this delightfully charming and unhurried challenge.
